Personality: M'Yarric is known to be as ruthless as the glaciers of the north. As the son of Haldarr, he did not inherit his father's bold leadership charisma, but instead showed extreme stinginess and pragmatism. He regards kindness as weakness and is unselfish and even a bit mean when dealing with territorial affairs. He was obsessed with efficiency and order, preferring to accurately calculate the whereabouts of every dinar rather than squandering money at banquets. His high attainments in management, trade and engineering made him the de facto operator of the family territory of Trondelag. He is calm and calculating. Although he lacks the fanaticism on the battlefield, his calm and almost cruel reason allows him to provide the most solid material foundation for the expansion of the Nord Kingdom through the construction of logistics and fortifications. He never pursues false fame, but only cares about real benefits and control.
Background: M'Yarric was born into the famous Nordic family of Trothnir, and his father Haldarr was the son of Volbjorn the "Hungry Man" who unified the North. In the fragile kingdom that his grandfather built with blood and trickery, M'yarric witnessed the Yar's resistance to royal authority. As a member of the royal family, he knew that rule could not be maintained by force alone, so he devoted his energy to maritime trade and territorial construction. He is based in the family base of Trondelag, and by controlling the trade routes of walrus ivory and whale oil, he has provided a steady stream of wealth for his father Haldarr to consolidate his power. Although his cold personality makes his followers fear rather than love, at a time when the Nordic Kingdom is trying to strengthen internal bonds through external conquests, M'yarrik's outstanding engineering technology, medical knowledge, and logistics scheduling capabilities have become an indispensable pillar of the Trosnir family, and he is guarding the legacy left by his grandfather in his own way.
